entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Praetor of the white-aligned Machine Orthodoxy who led New Phyrexia and the Phyrexian invasion until killed by Karn.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian-ruled plane (formerly Mirrodin) led by Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Machine Orthodoxy
entities.description: The white-aligned faction of New Phyrexia led by Elesh Norn, which became the Machine Legion.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker, the reconstructed Father of Machines, who breaks his pacifism to kill Norn.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: A Mirran angel compleated by Norn into the praetors' voice and given the task of destroying New Capenna.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: The blue-aligned praetor who pledged to Norn, then mutinied against her.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A praetor who rebelled against Norn and was executed by Ajani.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A praetor who declined to contribute to Atraxa and remained outside Norn's grasp, aiding the planeswalkers.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: The green praetor, manipulated by Norn and killed in the Zhalfiran melee.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker and newly anointed archangel who duels Norn, whom Norn fears.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A dryad planeswalker who fuses with Realmbreaker to summon Zhalfir.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who comes to New Phyrexia with a plan to stop Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: A planeswalker who joins Chandra and Wrenn.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A compleated planeswalker who serves Norn.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A compleated planeswalker who executes Sheoldred and is sent to Theros.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A planeswalker whose nightmare disrupts a compleation and who conjures Elspeth in Norn's armor.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who bargained access to his Planar Bridge and the Reality Chip for a darksteel body.

entities.name: Teferi Akosa
entities.description: Leader of the Zhalfiran army.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: A planeswalker on the strike team who hesitated to detonate the Sylex.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker on the strike team who hesitated to detonate the Sylex.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: A corrupt imitation of Kaldheim's World Tree that connects New Phyrexia to all planes.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: A lost plane shifted into New Phyrexia's place by Wrenn.

entities.name: Mirran rebels
entities.description: Rebels who hold off the Phyrexian army to buy Wrenn time.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The multiversal Phyrexian invasion overseen by Norn.

events.summary: Atraxa is captured at the Phyrexian conquest of Mirrodin and compleated by Norn, marking Phyrexia's final victory over Mirrodin.
events.quote: Atraxa's creation marked the final victory of Phyrexia over Mirrodin.

events.summary: Elesh Norn overwhelms Sheoldred's and Urabrask's forces and becomes the dominant praetor, the Mother of Machines.
events.quote: She then became the Mother of Machines, the highest power in New Phyrexia.

events.summary: Norn tries to compleat a Mirran woman, but the compleation fails because of a nightmare produced by Ashiok; Norn vows to kill Elspeth.
events.quote: Enraged, Norn vowed she would kill Elspeth

events.summary: Tezzeret bargains his Planar Bridge and the Reality Chip for a darksteel body, enabling the infiltrations of Kaldheim and Kamigawa.
events.quote: Norn felt confident to send troops across the planes.

events.summary: Sheoldred is sent to Dominaria to fetch Karn, whom Norn welcomes back as Father of Machines and introduces to Realmbreaker.
events.quote: Elesh Norn successfully sent Sheoldred to Dominaria in a large-scale infiltration to fetch Karn .

events.summary: A planeswalker strike team arrives too late to destroy Realmbreaker; Kaya and Kaito hesitate and Norn appears with compleated Nissa to thwart the mission as the invasion begins.
events.quote: This mistake was all it took for Norn to appear with a compleated Nissa Revane and thwart the mission.

events.summary: Norn's forces capture the rebelling Sheoldred and Norn has compleated Ajani execute her.
events.quote: Norn commanded the compleated planeswalker Ajani to execute Sheoldred, ending her rival's threat.

events.summary: Norn dispatches her compleated planeswalkers and Atraxa to conquer home planes, Theros and New Capenna.
events.quote: Finally, she gave the most important task to Atraxa .

events.summary: Chandra, Wrenn, Koth and Urabrask invade the inner spheres but are defeated at the Fair Basilica; Elspeth bursts from the Blind Eternities to save them.
events.quote: the newly anointed archangel Elspeth burst from the Blind Eternities, giving the planeswalkers time to escape

events.summary: Elspeth duels Norn to a stalemate, stabbing her through the shoulder, and flies off to cover the attack on Realmbreaker.
events.quote: was subsequently stabbed through the shoulder by Elspeth.

events.summary: Mirran rebels raise a barrier while Wrenn fuses with Realmbreaker to reach Zhalfir.
events.quote: Successfully merging herself with the cosmic tree, Wrenn reached out across the Multiverse

events.summary: Norn flings Elspeth through the barrier, shattering it, as Wrenn opens a portal summoning Teferi and the Zhalfiran army.
events.quote: Norn finally seized the angel planeswalker and flung her body through the barrier, shattering it.

events.summary: The Zhalfiran army turns the tide, Vorinclex is killed, and Wrenn shifts Zhalfir into New Phyrexia's place in the Multiverse.
events.quote: The Green Praetor Vorinclex was soon killed in the melee

events.summary: Teferi's forces strike Norn with a volley of magic.
events.quote: all striking Norn in the chest and further wounding her, though she continued to stand her ground.

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias mutinies and turns his army upon Norn.
events.quote: Jin-Gitaxias chose this time to mutiny

events.summary: Norn wipes out her assailants but is gravely wounded and crawls toward the portal to Zhalfir.
events.quote: Norn crawled toward the planar portal connecting New Phyrexia and Zhalfir

events.summary: Karn breaks his vow of pacifism and shreds Norn's mechanical components, killing her.
events.quote: broke his vow of pacifism and used his machine magic to shred her mechanical components

events.summary: Norn's death silences the Phyrexian hive mind, shutting down invaders across all planes and ending the multiversal invasion.
events.quote: This marked the end of the multiversal invasion.
